title: Color Debt
tagline: Borrow a color now. Pay it back before the board closes.
description: Every move borrows one color from the future. Match tiles to pay the debt, but matching too quickly leaves a bigger balance for the final row.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Color Debt. Every move borrows one color from the future. Match tiles to pay the debt, but matching too quickly leaves a bigger balance for the final row.
